name: Arken Markup Conversion v1
description: Bounded memory-only text-markup conversion: tolerant UTF-8 HTML to escaped CommonMark/GFM Markdown, a documented CommonMark subset (plus GFM tables and strikethrough) to sanitized HTML, and SRT <-> WebVTT subtitles with typed, line-numbered errors. No file, network, script or raw-HTML pass-through; no third-party dependencies.
